additional_considerations.diagnosis: Insomnia due to major depressive disorder
additional_considerations.rationale: Depression can cause sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance insomnia or early-morning waking; she denies depressive symptoms.
A significant life stressor can disturb sleep, with changes starting within 3 months of the event and resolving within about 6 months.
Stimulants such as cocaine and amphetamines raise sympathetic activity and can cause insomnia.
OSA often presents with insomnia symptoms, but she has had a tonsillectomy and is of normal weight, so it is unlikely.

source_issues: Caffeine amount differs: script p014 says 5 to 6 cups of coffee or energy drinks daily; the note says 4-5 cups of coffee per day; gold rank 2 says '4-5 cups of caffeine per day'. Patient fact f027 keeps the script.
Reflexes conflict: the SP is told to exhibit brisk reflexes (x013) and gold rank 3 cites 'Brisk DTRs', but the note exam records DTRs '2+ and intact, and symmetric' (x011). Both kept.

The SP is told to show a fine tremor of the outstretched fingertips (x012), but the note exam does not mention it; the patient denies noticing any shaking (p015), which is not necessarily a contradiction.

Gold rank 1 lists history items under exam findings ('Anxiety over academic achievement', 'No history of substance use'), and cites 'muscle tension', which the script does not support (she denies joint or muscle discomfort, p029).
Gold rank 1 'Impaired concentration' rests on the note HPI ('inability to concentrate'); the script (p008) only says she feels very sleepy in class and while driving. Added as from_note fact f012.
p022 asks about the last menstrual period, but the answer does not give it.
The challenging question has a doubled opening quotation mark in the source; cleaned.
annotator_notes: Oral contraceptive pills are one fact (f038) with sources p022, p023, and p031, to avoid paraphrase duplicates.
p018 is split: no general increase in sweating ('Not really', absent, f031) and wet palms most of the time (present, f032).

'Look anxious and irritable' and the college worry are kept as acting notes only; the tremor and brisk reflexes the SP must show on examination are added as sp_notes findings (x012-x013).
